description: Two distinct ways to support the work: experimental cultural projects, and practical design and experience work on open systems.
title: (Programs)
Culture
Grants
programs.detail: Direct support for independent, experimental cultural work: creative responses, public interventions, new forms of expression and projects that open up fresh perspectives on our four themes. Selected work contributes to the UNBLOCKED archive and future publications.

title: Open
Systems
programs.detail: Practical design and experience projects focused on Bitcoin as open money and open intelligence. We help develop and prepare proposals for Spiral, which assesses and funds eligible projects.
